jobs.occupation: (Senior) Brand Manager for Animal Health Global Brands (Content-Marketing-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will support strategic marketing initiatives for individual brand(s), including long-term category strategy development for a portfolio to support success in strategic markets based on deep customer understanding.
- With a strong strategic focus, you will drive the Brand Plan and strategy deployment, including strategic pricing guidance, category focus, geo expansion, and clear prioritization.
- Working closely with the Franchise Head/Senior Brand Manager, you will support the development of marketing campaigns for brand(s) across veterinary and/or non-veterinary channels, resulting in channel-specific portfolio campaigns.
- In close collaboration with GCB, you will support the Franchise Head in governing brand strategy execution, including KPI definition and brand equity tracking in strategic countries.
- As part of the portfolio team, you will contribute to defining life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L initiatives.
- To enable successful execution, you will help define key strategic initiatives to achieve product targets, including must-win priorities.
- Additionally, you will drive digital transformation in marketing and promotion for brands and collaborate across the franchise and the wider pet business.
- Furthermore, you will support the development of brand guidance and brand positioning, ensuring that new and existing brands fit coherently into the portfolio and managing related changes (e.g. packaging, positioning, LCM).

Additional tasks for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Additionally, you will tailor brand strategies and strategic initiatives for (R)OPU archetypes, with a strong focus on strategic countries.
- Furthermore, you will define life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L opportunities within the category.
- At the same time, you will lead the development of marketing campaigns across all relevant channels, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation.
- Beyond this, you will develop brand guidance and positioning, ensuring alignment of new and existing brands within the portfolio and steering changes such as packaging, positioning, and LCM.
- Finally, you will support the Franchise Head in overall franchise strategy development while being accountable for the brand/project budget and adherence.

Requirements

- University degree required; Master degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) highly desirable
- Highly specialized knowledge and work experience in different parts of business, including Marketing roles in local & regional roles. Sales role experience is desirable.
- Requires strong understanding of business operations across regional/local levels and different geographic specificities, portfolio specifics.
- Strong strategic marketing and analytical capabilities
- Fluent command of English

Additional requirements for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Long-term brand management experience; exposure to local and operational strategic marketing
- Proven project leadership and project management experience; budget and resource oversight
- Deep understanding of regional and local business operations, geographic specificities, and portfolio dynamics
- Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to influence and gain buy-in in a cross-cultural, matrixed environment
- Excellent strategic marketing mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities
- High agility; ability to evolve strategic and tactical approaches based on research data and industry trends

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.

The Position
Are you passionate about innovation, finding cutting-edge solutions and creating value where it matters, around the globe? At the BI global Inflammation team, we strive to deliver innovative Therapeutic and patient centric solutions by putting the patient in the center of everything we do. We foster innovative thinking as well as an agile and collaborative way of working to advance our novel programs and capabilities in Therapeutic Area Inflammation.
The Global TA Inflammation, (Senior) HEOR  Manager, brings technical expertise, driving Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Patient Related Outcomes fostering our patient centric drive. His/she will support the TA Market Access Head by providing oversight, direction, and functional support on HEOR & PRO & Access projects. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.
- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.
- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.
- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.
- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.
- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.

Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:

- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.
- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.

Requirements

- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health
- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities
- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products
- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs
- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets
- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption
- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)
- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data
- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external context

Additional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:

- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities
- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis
- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication
- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)

For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.

jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.

The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at the Faculty of Biological Sciences seeks to fill the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Viral Ecology (m/f/d)

commencing on 01 December 2026. We offer a part-time position (65%, 26 hours per week), with a fixed-term employment until 30 June 2030.

The DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre 1768 “VirusREvolution: Decoding tools for virus research” is a highly ambitious research centre at Friedrich Schiller University with the joint goal to develop novel tools for virus discovery, characterisation, regulation, interaction, and visualisation (https://virusrevolution.uni-jena.de/). Its integrated research training group is educating doctoral researchers in a structured, interdisciplinary training program and invites applications for doctoral and postdoctoral researcher positions in various fields of research.
In this doctoral project “Do viruses exploit their quasispecies for host range evolution?”, you will investigate how host range and environmental conditions shape virus diversity and virus-host interactions in natural and experimentally manipulated microbial communities.
Conduct experimental work and analyses on virus-host interactions in soil and groundwater ecosystems, including host-range assays, environmental sampling, and targeted microcosm experiments
Analyse metagenomic and viromic data sets from soil and groundwater samples to identify broad- and narrow-host-range viruses to characterize their quasispecies characteristics
Participation in the Collaborative Research Centre VirusREvolution and close collaboration with the tandem project partner

Collaborate with BSc and MSc students working in associated projects
Publish papers and present your work at national and international scientific meetings

jobs.employer_name: INM - Leibniz-Institut für Neue Materialien gGmbH
jobs.description:
Introduction

The INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials is an internationally leading center for interdisciplinary research on materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological engineering, physical analysis, process engineering and data science. We collaborate with academic and industrial partners all around the world.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
Very good communication skills in English.

Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
Transparent opportunities for career development.
Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
A family-friendly working place.
A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset and a flexible approach to work are essential. - Proactively contact interested families, provide relevant information and identify their individual needs.
- Manage and respond to all incoming enquiries from prospective families in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate records in the admissions database and ensure consistent follow-up throughout the enquiry process.
- Conduct school tours during regular school operations and provide personalised guidance on ISR’s educational programs and school community.
- Support prospective families throughout the entire application and enrolment process.
- Represent ISR and present its educational concept at internal and external events.
- Attend and actively support the planning, coordination, and delivery of information sessions, open days, and Saturday Info Days.
- Build positive and trusting relationships with prospective families while ensuring a welcoming and professional experience at every stage

Qualifications

- Completed vocational training or a university degree.
- Previous experience in customer service, client advisory or sales.
- Excellent written and spoken English and German; additional language skills would be an advantage.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional, service-oriented and approachable manner.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility, reliability and strong organisational skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Veracross is an advantage

Job Benefits

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you are enthusiastic, highly motivated, enjoy a challenge, and believe you can contribute to the continued growth and development of our new ISR Elementary School Düsseldorf, we would be delighted to hear from you.

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.

In the department Bioanalytics for the Multidimensional OMICS Data Analysis research group, we invite applications for a:

PhD Candidate (m/f/d)

This position is part of the Leibniz Science Campus “Cardio-Oncology Campus for Precision Medicine”, with focus on the analysis and development of biomarker profiles for the personalized assessment of cardiovascular risks associated with cancer therapy.

Non-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.

The full-time position is available immediately. It is fixed-termed and offered until September 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).
Analysis of phenotypic, microscopic, PET/MRI, MALDI-MSI, and LC-MS/MS data
Development of AI-based models for personalized risk assessment
Validation and application of model performance using established biomarkers and patient cohorts
Evaluation, analysis, and visualization of data
Documentation of laboratory work
Collaboration with project partners and regular presentation of results

M.Sc. or Diploma in bioinformatics or a comparable qualification
Extensive programming experience
Practical experience in machine learning and the application of large language models
Knowledge of OMICS and image data analysis

Strong communication skills, organisational talent and a solution-oriented approach
Proficiency in MS Office

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about advancing compliance excellence in a global healthcare environment? Join our Human Pharma Compliance team and be a strategic business partner to Human Pharma stakeholders. You will contribute to key global compliance initiatives, help shape the evolution of Boehringer Ingelheim's healthcare compliance framework, and play an important role in steering our global Transparency Reporting & Disclosure framework. Through your work, you will help strengthen integrity and transparency while supporting sustainable business success across our global organization.
This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 2-3 days per week on site.
This position is limited for 1 year.
This position is part time eligible with 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As a strategic business partner, you will provide both strategic and operational compliance guidance to Human Pharma stakeholders. By understanding business priorities and assessing compliance considerations, you will help stakeholders navigate complex challenges, make informed decisions, and develop practical, risk-based solutions that enable sustainable business success.
- You will play a key role in operating and continuously evolving our global Transparency Reporting & Disclosure framework and other Human Pharma Compliance initiatives, collaborating with stakeholders across functions and countries to enhance transparency, strengthen compliance processes, and support consistent implementation across our global organization.
- You will contribute to the development and implementation of global Compliance Program elements, including policies, guidelines, training initiatives, monitoring activities, investigations, and risk assessments, in line with the overall compliance strategy.
- Working closely with Corporate Human Pharma colleagues and the global compliance network across countries, you will foster collaboration, share best practices, and help drive a consistent, risk-based, and effective compliance approach throughout the organization.

Requirements

- Master's degree in Law, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with several years of healthcare compliance experience in an international, cross-border environment.
- Strong knowledge of healthcare compliance requirements and industry standards, coupled with proven experience in compliance program management within the pharmaceutical industry.
- Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and sound judgment, with the ability to analyze complex situations, balance compliance requirements with business objectives, and develop pragmatic, risk-based solutions in a dynamic and highly regulated environment.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a track record of delivering high-quality outcomes in complex situations.
- Proven experience leading projects and influencing cross-functional stakeholders in a matrix environment, including coordinating teams and driving results without direct reporting authority.
- Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build trusted partnerships across functions, regions, and global compliance networks, driving alignment and shared solutions in a matrix environment.
- Business fluent English language skills. Fluent German language skills are a plus, as well as international working experience.

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &

opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company

jobs.description:
Would you like to do more than simply observe and instead actively contribute to challenging transformation projects in an international environment?

Who We Are

We are a specialized boutique consultancy in the field of digital transformation, with a focus on:

- Process management
- Project management
- Quality assurance in ERP projects
- ERP solution architecture in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment
- Data analytics and business intelligence

Our projects are primarily conducted in international contexts and combine functional, technical and organizational perspectives.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for motivated seasoned veterans (m/f/d) who have extensive professional experience and would like to learn something new in the areas of project management (Office) and control tower functions in ERP implementation projects.

What You Should Bring

- Curiosity and intrinsic motivation to learn something new again
- A strong willingness to learn and work independently
- Interest in digital business processes and ERP systems
- Very good German and good English language skills, as our projects have an international focus
- A structured and analytical way of thinking

Prior experience in project management or Microsoft Dynamics 365 is beneficial, but not a mandatory requirement.

Your Responsibilities

- Supporting the analysis and optimization of business processes
- Contributing to ERP implementation projects
- Assisting with project management and quality assurance activities
- Contributing to the design and documentation of solution architectures
- Independently working on clearly defined subject areas

From the very beginning, you will work on real client projects and take on responsibility, while receiving appropriate guidance and regular professional exchange.

What We Offer

- A personal, appreciative and relaxed working and learning environment
- Plenty of freedom to independently explore new topics
- Direct collaboration with executive management
- Insights into international transformation projects
- Flexible working arrangements
- Prospects for future permanent employment

But what’s even more important is that we’ll prepare you for your new challenge. With us, you’ll receive structured on-the-job training in project management and project methodologies for ERP implementation projects, along with the corresponding certifications.

Our ambition is not only to deliver successful projects, but also to support the professional development of people.

If you are interested in growing in an entrepreneurial environment and actively contributing to digital transformation, we look forward to receiving your application, including a brief motivation letter and your CV.
